items.name: Dogslicer
items.description: This short, curved, and crude makeshift blade often has holes drilled into it to reduce its weight. It's a favored weapon of goblins.

items.name: Alchemist's Fire (Moderate)
items.description:
Activate A Strike

Alchemist's fire is a combination of volatile liquids that ignite when exposed to air. Alchemist's fire deals 2d8 fire damage, 2 persistent fire damage, and 2 fire splash damage. You gain a +1 item bonus to attack rolls.

items.name: Glue Bomb (Moderate)
items.description:
Activate 1 Strike

A glue bomb is a harmless explosive mechanism bursting with sticky substances. When you hit a creature with a glue bomb, that creature takes a –15-foot status penalty to its Speeds for 1 minute. You gain a +1 item bonus to attack rolls, and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Escape] DC is 19.

On a critical hit, a creature in contact with a solid surface becomes stuck to the surface and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Immobilized] for 1 round, and a creature flying via wings has its wings tangled, causing it to fall safely to the ground and become unable to Fly again for 1 round. Glue bombs are not effective when used on a creature that is in water.

The target can end any effects by Escaping or spending a total of 3 Interact actions to carefully remove the sticky substances. These Interact actions don't have to be consecutive, and other creatures can provide the actions as well.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.Effect: Glue Bomb]

items.name: Studded Leather Armor
items.description: This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

generalAbilities.name: Infused Items
generalAbilities.description: Tunch carries the following infused items, which last for 24 hours or until the next time he makes his daily preparations: Alchemist's Fire (Moderate) (8), Antidote (Lesser) (2), Elixir of Life (Lesser) (4), Glue Bomb (Moderate) (2)

defensiveAbilities.name: Goblin Scuttle
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A goblin ally ends a move action adjacent to the goblin.

Effect The goblin Steps.

offensiveAbilities.name: Calculated Splash
offensiveAbilities.description: When Tunch throws a bomb with the splash trait, it deals splash damage equal to his Intelligence modifier.

offensiveAbilities.name: Distracting Whistle
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect Tunch whistles in a way that causes the sound to manifest elsewhere, potentially distracting a foe. One target of Tunch's choice that he can see within 30 feet must attempt a DC 22 Will Saving Throw save or become Off-Guard until the start of Tunch's next turn by the distracting whistling sound that seems to come from behind them. The target is then temporarily immune to Distracting Whistle for 1 hour.

offensiveAbilities.name: Quick Bomber
offensiveAbilities.description: Tunch Interacts to draw a bomb, then Strikes with it.
